description: This file defines an interface named IPlacementFilterDirector used for filtering silos during placement strategies in Orleans.

classes.name: IPlacementFilterDirector
classes.description: An interface that specifies a method for filtering silo addresses based on a placement filter strategy and target.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters a collection of silos based on the specified placement filter strategy and target, returning the filtered silo addresses.
